meta.description: Use Boltz2 NIM for biomolecular structure prediction and binding affinity. Invoke for Boltz2, protein structures, protein-ligand/DNA/RNA complexes, SMILES or CCD ligands, pIC50/IC50 affinity scoring, mmCIF output, hosted NVIDIA API calls, or local Docker deployment.

scientific_integrity.detail: No DOIs, PMIDs, or clinical trial IDs cited; all quantitative values are simulated examples for demonstration; uses valid biological sequences (KRAS), correct SMILES notation, and standard CCD codes (ATP, GTP, HEM)

practice_boundaries.detail: Not a medical skill; focuses on computational structure prediction; Output 2 includes appropriate disclaimer that model estimates should be validated experimentally

methodological_ground.detail: Appropriate use of Boltz2 for structure prediction; method matches data type; confidence scores interpreted correctly with lower confidence for complex systems explained; operates on sequence data without patient data or human subjects research

code_usability.detail: All Python code syntactically valid; no syntax errors, infinite loops, or logical bugs detected; dependencies (os, requests>=2.28) documented and installable; code runnable with documented prerequisites (NGC_API_KEY, Docker setup)

functional_suitability.note: Complete coverage of Docker setup, request patterns, MSA handling, affinity prediction, output saving, validation, and troubleshooting; reference files provide deeper details via progressive disclosure

reliability.note: Documents common 422 errors, provides readiness checks, includes timeout settings; no retry logic for transient failures or graceful degradation patterns

performance_context.note: Main SKILL.md is 147 lines with excellent progressive disclosure via 5 reference files; first Docker startup downloads 30GB (documented)

agent_usability.note: Clear structure with progressive disclosure, consistent patterns, explicit decision tree (hosted vs local), preflight script prevents common setup errors; no progress indicators for long-running predictions

human_usability.note: Clear section headers and reference file pointers; hosted vs local decision is prominent; some advanced features (constraints, modifications) require reference diving

security.note: Environment variables for API keys, .env file support, no hardcoded secrets, proper Docker secret passing with -e NGC_API_KEY, server-side input validation, proper cache scoping

maintainability.note: Excellent modularity with main SKILL.md and 5 reference files; API endpoint is a variable, version pinned in Docker image (1.6.0), parameter defaults are clear; no unit tests or mock responses for CI/CD

agent_specific.note: Excellent trigger precision with comprehensive list in description; perfect progressive disclosure (147-line main file + references); explicit handoffs to MSA-Search, GenMol, DiffDock; warning about not overwriting samples in loops; AskUserQuestion allowed for hosted vs local choice

recommendations.title: Enhance retry logic for transient failures
recommendations.problem: No retry logic for transient API failures (network timeouts, 5xx errors). Single requests.post() call with raise_for_status() but no retry wrapper.
recommendations.root_cause: Static evaluation identified gap in fault tolerance (Reliability 2.1 scored 9/12).
recommendations.fix: Add example retry logic in main SKILL.md or references/examples.md using requests.Session with HTTPAdapter and Retry configuration (total=3, backoff_factor=1, status_forcelist=[500, 502, 503, 504]).

recommendations.title: Add explicit seed/reproducibility guidance
recommendations.problem: Stochastic sampling parameters mentioned but no seed parameter documented. Unclear whether exact reproducibility is achievable.
recommendations.root_cause: Static evaluation identified gap in idempotency (Agent-Specific 8.4 scored 3/4).
recommendations.fix: Clarify in parameters.md or main SKILL.md whether step_scale or other parameters control determinism, or if API supports a seed parameter for exact reproducibility across runs with identical inputs.

recommendations.title: Expand escape hatch patterns
recommendations.problem: No explicit 'beyond my scope' pattern for requests outside Boltz2 capabilities. Handoffs section in science.md could be more prominent.
recommendations.root_cause: Static evaluation identified gap in escape hatches (Agent-Specific 8.5 scored 3/4).
recommendations.fix: Add to main SKILL.md after 'Choose Mode' section: Out of Scope section listing what this skill is NOT appropriate for (virtual screening of large compound libraries → use DiffDock; protein design/sequence optimization → use ProteinMPNN or RFdiffusion; molecular dynamics simulations → use external MD packages). Instruct agent to ask user to clarify intent if request matches these patterns.
